ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_bayesian_infer_advantage_w_variance_reg
ir.intuition: Shift from margin and rank probability based loss to a Bayesian-inspired inference loss that models the posterior probability of the winner being better using logistic link with uncertainty modeled by advantage_w variance. The loss incorporates a variance-based regularizer that penalizes high uncertainty in advantage_w, promoting confident predictions, and aggregates via weighted harmonic mean to emphasize pairs with low loss more strongly.
ir.pseudocode:
eps = 1e-12
mu = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * advantage_w
mu_clamped = clamp(mu, -20, 20)
prob_win = sigmoid(mu_clamped)
base_loss = -weight * log(prob_win + eps)
variance_adv = mean((advantage_w - mean(advantage_w))^2 * weight) / mean(weight)
variance_reg = gamma * variance_adv
weighted_harmonic_mean = sum(weight) / sum(weight / (base_loss + eps))
final_loss = weighted_harmonic_mean + variance_reg
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('gamma', 0.1)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.5))
    eps = 1e-12

    mu = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, advantage_w))
    mu = ops.clamp(mu, -20.0, 20.0)
    prob_win = ops.sigmoid(mu)
    base_loss = ops.neg(ops.mul(weight, ops.log(ops.add(prob_win, eps))))

    adv_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(weight, advantage_w)), ops.sum(weight) + eps)
    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_w, adv_mean)
    weighted_var = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(ops.mul(adv_diff, adv_diff), weight)), ops.sum(weight) + eps)

    variance_reg = ops.mul(gamma, weighted_var)

    weighted_loss_sum = ops.sum(base_loss)
    weighted_loss_inv = ops.div(weight, ops.add(base_loss, eps))
    harmonic_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(weight), ops.sum(weighted_loss_inv))

    final_loss = ops.add(harmonic_mean, variance_reg)
    return final_loss
